blocks.text: Catalyzed microcement with micronized quartz, offering excellent workability and hardness thanks to a combination of latest-generation resins developed exclusively for our range. Micronized coating suitable for floors and walls.

Open the bucket and add the hardener to the ready-to-use paste; stir with a mechanical mixer until a completely homogeneous mix is obtained.
Apply 1 or 2 coats, depending on the required thickness, with a steel trowel held at an angle of about 45° and applying some pressure on the material.
The open time, before the material starts to harden and set, is approximately 40 to 60 minutes.
Depending on temperature, humidity and working method, the product can be adjusted in terms of drying, hardness, workability and grain size to the customer's preference.
